en: \[Claude Tag] Added Slack's native Working indicator, Stop button and thread title to Claude's threads in channels; the indicator stays up until Claude finishes, and Stop interrupts the task
zh: \[Claude Tag] 在频道中 Claude 的 thread 里新增 Slack 原生的进行中指示器、停止按钮和 thread 标题；指示器会一直显示到 Claude 完成，停止按钮可中断任务
